captions.detailed: A compact, desktop air purifier featuring a cylindrical drum body. The main body is colored in a clean off-white, while the base, top rim, and central exhaust cap are finished in contrasting matte black. A rectangular, side-hinged filter access panel is mounted on the curved surface, matching the off-white color and featuring a black latch mechanism.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact desktop air purifier using CadQuery. The model should have a cylindrical off-white body, a black base ring, a black stepped top exhaust cap, and a rectangular, side-hinged filter access panel with a black latch.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a cylinder primitive for the central housing and another for the base. Create the top exhaust cap with a series of stepped, concentric cylinders. Build the filter access panel from a box primitive, positioned on the outer radius of the main cylinder, and add a small box representing the latch mechanism.
